title: The Adventures of Andy Applebutter
overview: Join Andy and his friends on an adventure where life lessons are learned with each new journey. Both episodes nurture social skills and important life lessons in a fun lighthearted way. Begin the journey with Andy AppleButter as he experiences the challenge of being a new kid on the block. Be part of Andy's adventure as he meets new friends and learns how to overcome being bullied by other kids. Meanwhile, join Cha-Cha Cola on her experience of meeting The Sisters of Spice as she joins a new softball team. Cha-Cha Cola and The Sisters of Spice learn that great team work happens when they all work together.
